baseline: H0: DM-20260908-v1 60-observation residual momentum, EWMA alpha=0.25
B00: prior-only 250-observation new-high Long / new-low Short breakout, EWMA alpha=0.25

trials.description: Annual expanding Ridge on five box/pre-breakout features for prior-only 250-observation new-high events; 50/50 Long score blend with B00, Short leg retained

feature_definitions.box_duration: Largest L in {5,10,...,120} with prior-only High-Max minus Low-Min divided by prior ATR20 below 3; windows end at t-1.
feature_definitions.box_width_atr: Selected longest qualifying box range divided by prior ATR20; missing when no L qualifies.
feature_definitions.close_position: (Close(t-1)-box lower)/(box upper-box lower) for the selected box; no clipping.
feature_definitions.relative_strength_60: 60-observation skip-one market residual return rank, identical to H0.
feature_definitions.breakout_event: At t, Close_t exceeds the maximum High from t-250 through t-1; raw OHLC is converted to common share units using observed AdjustmentFactor events.
feature_definitions.missing_history: No qualifying box is box_duration=0 and missing width/position; Ridge imputation uses training rows only.

model: Fit an expanding annual Ridge (lambda=1.0) on high-breakout rows only, using daily centered full-cross-section target ranks and the five independent box/context features. Rank predictions among same-day high-breakout rows and blend 50/50 with B00's Long event score; preserve B00 Short score.

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive Train-only diagnostics. No selection or adoption because all Train periods are known.
